copy.headline: Texas A&M names Thornton interim athletic director, effective Dec. 1
copy.caption:
John Thornton will take over as interim athletic director at Texas A&M, effective Dec. 1, replacing the departed Trev Alberts. Thornton will fill in while the university conducts a search for a permanent replacement for Trev Alberts, who will leave Nov. 30 to become Michigan's athletic director.

Texas A&M president Susan Ballabina announced the decision Monday.

story.title: Texas A&M names Thornton interim athletic director, effective Dec. 1
story.summary: John Thornton will take over as interim athletic director at Texas A&M, effective Dec. 1, replacing the departed Trev Alberts. COLLEGE STATION, Texas -- John Thornton has been named Texas A&M's interim athletic director and will take over Dec. 1. Thornton will fill in while the university conducts a search for a permanent replacement for Trev Alberts, who will leave Nov. 30 to become Michigan's athletic director . Texas A&M president Susan Ballabina announced the decision Monday. "With more than four decades of experience at Texas A&M University as a student-athlete, coach and administrator, Dr. Thornton knows our university and our athletics program well," she said in a letter announcing the move. "We are fortunate to have someone with his experience and commitment to Texas A&M step into this role." It will be the second time Thornton has served as A&M's interim athletic director…
